lines.text: Today you will build your own AI helper that already knows your FAQ and your rules.
A custom assistant is a saved setup: instructions plus reference files, so you do not repeat yourself in every chat.
Claude has Projects, ChatGPT has custom GPTs and Projects, and Gemini has Gems.
Which ones you can create depends on your plan, so check your account.
Use the 4 parts again: who it is, who it helps, how it answers, and the format.
Add rules: answer only from the files, and if the answer is missing, say so.
Add what it must never do, like promise discounts.
Add public, up-to-date files like your FAQ, price list, timings and return policy.
Never add customer lists, staff salaries, passwords or bank details.
When a price changes, update the file the same day.
Ask it things not in the files, an angry message, a question in Hindi, and a request for private information.
Write each test and result in a test log.
When it fails, fix the instructions and test again.
All three big tools let you save instructions and files as your own assistant.
In Claude it is a project, in ChatGPT a GPT or project, and in Gemini a Gem.
If your plan does not show the option, paste your saved instructions at the start of a new chat.
We test our shop helper with a product that is not in the price list.
It says it does not have the details, and sends the customer to the shop.
That is exactly what our instructions asked for: no guessing about prices.
Now a test it fails: a customer asks for a Sunday delivery.
The assistant happily says yes, but our FAQ says we are closed on Sundays.
We add a rule: answer only from the FAQ, and never promise delivery days that are not listed.
Then we ask the same question again, and write both results in our test log.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
